title: unit-cost-sandbox-variant-scenarios
summary: Sandbox spreadsheet used to evaluate alternative unit-cost assumptions across regions and model families for the Hosted API. Purpose: quick 'what-if' variants to surface high-leverage optimizations (caching, quantization mix, routing) and prioritize small experiments that change per-request economics by >5%.

assumptions:
- BaseTokenCost_per_1k: estimated infra cost per 1000 tokens served (includes GPU amortization + infra ops).
- QuantizedFactor: multiplier applied to base token cost to represent cheaper execution for quantized model variant (0.65 means 35% cheaper).
- KVCacheHitRate: fraction of tokens avoided via prefix/KV cache; assumed uniform token reduction on long contexts.
- EffectiveTokenCost_per_request = (BaseTokenCost_per_1k * QuantizedFactor * AvgTokensPerRequest / 1000) * (1 - KVCacheHitRate).
- PriceCharged_per_request: example list price applied in this sandbox (not final).
- Sensitivity_+10pct_GPU_cost: delta in margin per request if GPU-related component increases by 10%.
- Exchange rates and cloud egress costs modeled separately (not included in this sheet), but regional BaseTokenCost captures average historical impression of those elements.
action_items:
- Run three small experiments within 6 weeks: (A) Enable quantized-default routing for small-model traffic in US/EU, (B) Deploy prefix-KV cache for top 200 user prompts, measure hit rate, (C) Add cross-region fallback policy for large-model requests to US-west when APAC quota is saturated.
- Owner assignments: A: Marcus Chen; B: Naomi Ruiz; C: Samir Kulkarni.
- Measurement plan: track EffectiveTokenCost_per_request, observed KVCacheHitRate, p50/p95 latency, request rejection rate, and net margin delta weekly.
- Decision thresholds: if margin improves by >5% without >10% p95 latency regression, roll change to prod; else iterate.
sensitivity_notes:
- Small-model quantization yields the largest low-effort wins (15–30% per-request cost reduction in our assumptions).
- Large-model routing and regional placement have outsized impact on margin due to higher AvgTokensPerRequest; small changes in GPU price or utilization produce large margin swings.
- Embeddings are low-cost per token but high-volume; caching repeated vectors and batching can reduce unit cost meaningfully.
- Recommendation: prioritize caching + quantization experiments before pricing changes or capacity commits.
- Caveat: latency SLOs may constrain batch sizes; measure real p95 impacts in canary traffic.
notes_to_reviewers:
This file is intentionally a fast-moving sandbox (not canonical financial model). Use it to prioritize low-effort technical experiments that translate immediately into per-token savings. For reconciliation with official finance forecasts, we will export a reconciled slice after experiments complete and submit INF-1293 for accounting update.
Questions for reviewers: are regional surcharge assumptions for APAC appropriate? Should we include egress and KMS costs explicitly in next iteration?
